question:
A wedge is cut from a $6$-cm cylinder as shown by the dashed curve. Which answer choice is closest to the volume of the wedge in cubic centimeters?
Choices:
A:48
B:75
C:151
D:192
E:603
view_evidence: original_montage_1.png or original_montage_2.png; individual originals also viewed for all designed questions.
specific_assessment: Cylinder has original6cm axial dimension and8cm diameter, oblique wedge curve. Considered diameter-to-curve or axial-to-cut-length pairing. No precise receiver supporting a particular wrong wedge fraction without inventing a cut-angle or masking dimensions; radius/diameter or omitted-pi emphasis alone was not retained.
